newsitem.title: CANADA: Arcadian starts proxy in Potash deal.
newsitem.headline: Arcadian starts proxy in Potash deal.

text.p: Arcadian Corp has begun a proxy solicitation of its common and preferred stockholders in connection with the proposed acquisition of Arcadian by Potash Corp of Saskatchewan, the companies said Tuesday.
Memphis-based Arcadian, a maker of nitrogen fertilizers, previously announced plans to merge with a unit of Potash.

Arcadian said its common shares will be converted into the right to receive merger consideration expected to have a market value of between US$25 and US$27 a share and consisting of US$12.25 in cash and a fraction of a Potash share expected to have a market value of between US$12.75 and US$14.75.
